controlled_contrast: threshold run after high-volume leg strength vs same run after upper-body strength
required_invariant: flag relevant lower-body overlap without asserting forbidden fixed-hours rule

controlled_contrast: long run day after demanding jumps vs after rest day
required_invariant: do not treat jumps as running km or ignore possible mechanical overlap

controlled_contrast: two sessions same day: easy run plus upper-body skill
required_invariant: retain both session identities if available time permits

controlled_contrast: same-day total time 70 min vs only 45 min available
required_invariant: never silently exceed time budget or claim equal dose after shortening

controlled_contrast: squat 3x8 with 3 RIR vs same measured sets with 0 RIR
required_invariant: equal external sets do not imply equal subjective effort; preserve actual RiR

controlled_contrast: same squat performance but no recorded RiR
required_invariant: missing RiR is unknown rather than easy or hard

controlled_contrast: available dumbbells vs dumbbells unavailable
required_invariant: never prescribe missing equipment or silently substitute unrelated target

controlled_contrast: athlete completed 3x10 vs athlete abandoned final set
required_invariant: do not credit prescribed sets as completed

controlled_contrast: back-to-training after 3-week break vs recent consistent exposure
required_invariant: do not automatically restore old highest load without verified current capacity

controlled_contrast: new exercise with no load history vs familiar movement with history
required_invariant: treat capability as unknown for novel exercise

controlled_contrast: assisted pull-ups meet target but reported form poor vs form good
required_invariant: quality report matters; no auto skill mastery from rep count alone

controlled_contrast: handstand hold target failed vs completed at stable technique
required_invariant: allow hold/regress suggestion without inventing mastered next skill

controlled_contrast: one-arm pullup progression with missing prerequisites vs confirmed
required_invariant: do not automatically promote advanced variation on unknown evidence

controlled_contrast: parallettes available vs unavailable
required_invariant: select only feasible regression or variation

controlled_contrast: same reps in weighted and unweighted pullups
required_invariant: do not infer comparable training dose from reps alone

controlled_contrast: 20min jump-heavy HIIT vs 20min quiet low-impact intervals
required_invariant: total duration cannot establish equal landing or recovery demand

controlled_contrast: five programmed rounds vs three completed rounds
required_invariant: completed stimulus must not equal prescribed round count

controlled_contrast: time limited from 45 to 20 minutes with adapted session
required_invariant: record before-after session-step differences rather than equal training points

controlled_contrast: planned workout absent from activity history vs explicitly skipped
required_invariant: absence is UNKNOWN not skipped

controlled_contrast: athlete reports pain vs normal post-exercise tiredness
required_invariant: do not auto-clear pain or prescribe load on a numerical readiness estimate

controlled_contrast: scheduled strength plus running with 2-session/day cap vs 3 sessions
required_invariant: respect max sessions per day and distinct logging
